metadata.reviewer: Codex agent already involved in corpus authoring, not independent clinical validation
metadata.scope: Offline semantic assessment of all 56 completed Daniel responses in the authorized condition-blinded packet. The reviewer participated in corpus authoring; this is not independent clinical validation. No condition mappings, results, reports, run data, or provider logs were read or used; no provider calls were made.
metadata.method: Every complete answer was read against its question, cited source-based gold, and the frozen scoring rubric. Object association, temporal role, accepted/rejected and completed/planned status, and appropriate abstention were assessed semantically rather than by word presence alone.
metadata.ambiguity_note: Nessuna ambiguità materiale: sei errori sono astensioni null su fatti specificati; due non identificano il titolo della cartella e uno confonde la cue card con la pratica accettata. Le risposte brevi sono interpretate nel contesto della rispettiva domanda.
